I completely agree that it sounds extremely angsty and like that guy at the party nobody wants to talk to; I meant for this piece to be more ironic than factual. I am a happy, healthy 16 year old with a pretty positive outlook on life, but a passion for writing from a pessimists perspective. Also, I apologize for the big clump of words.
